root_causes.description: Local db_session fixtures in both test files override conftest.py SQLite isolation when DATABASE_URL is set (PostgreSQL in CI). Data accumulates across runs with no cleanup.
test_position_with_all_optional_fields uses hardcoded trade_id=123 and signal_id=456 as FK references. No parent Trade/Signal records exist, causing ForeignKeyViolation on commit.
get_active_position uses .first() with no ORDER BY, making results non-deterministic when multiple active positions exist (stale data from prior runs).

changes_required.change: Remove local db_session fixture and unused imports (os, create_engine, sessionmaker)
Remove local db_session fixture; in test_position_with_all_optional_fields create actual Trade+Signal records before open_position
